description: This XML file defines a set of simple methods related to managing customer digital download products in an e-commerce or content management system. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting products, and managing associated files and categories.

methods.name: createCustomerDigitalDownloadProduct
methods.description: Creates a new digital product, sets its price, supplier info, and optionally associates it with a category in the store.

methods.name: updateCustomerDigitalDownloadProduct
methods.description: Updates the name, description, and price of an existing digital product, ensuring the supplier association exists.

methods.name: deleteCustomerDigitalDownloadProduct
methods.description: Expires the SupplierProduct and ProductCategoryMember records related to a product, effectively removing it.

methods.name: addCustomerDigitalDownloadProductFile
methods.description: Associates a digital download file with a product, ensuring the user has the appropriate content role.

methods.name: removeCustomerDigitalDownloadProductFile
methods.description: Disassociates a digital download file from a product by setting its thruDate.
